_comment: Line-coverage settings for `mix coveralls.*` (excoveralls), #1314.
`minimum_coverage` is a FLOOR, not a target: it sits just under the number
the full suite measured when it was last moved, so coverage cannot regress
silently. When a PR raises the measured number by a whole point or more,
raise this to just under the new number in the same PR. Never lower it to
make a red build green — that is the regression it exists to surface.
`skip_files` are regexes on the source path. test/support is compiled
into the app under MIX_ENV=test (see elixirc_paths/1 in mix.exs) but is
test scaffolding, not code under test. Modules a dependency's macro
generates into this app (Spark DSL extensions, AshGraphql subscription
config, Postgrex type module, …) report under the dependency's own
source file — an absolute path into deps/ — and are that dependency's
code, not ours.
Measured 2026-08-20 on the full suite, after merging main into this branch:
83.1% locally (7,344 tests). CI (ubuntu-latest) excludes the :qpdf tests and
so reads a step lower — it was 82.9% when the local number was 83.0%. The
floor is set from the CI number, that being the environment that enforces
it, and stays at 82.5 here: the rule above moves it on a whole point, not a
tenth. Re-state this measurement whenever you move the floor, so the next
reader can tell what the floor was actually checked against.
terminal_options.print_files: the per-file table is off; the per-directory
rollup (`mix kiln.coverage.summary`) is the readable view, and the HTML
report has every file. `mix coveralls.detail` still prints sources.
